interpretation: Complete document retention does not eliminate the reader/gold mismatch; context omission cannot explain all errors.
Locally complete groups may omit a governing exception header or confuse receipt, onward disclosure, permission, creation and retention.
Native and positional trade three binary wins each. High-confidence native errors produce worse NLL despite equal binary accuracy. These saved cases do not establish causation or generalization.
limitations: Post-hoc purposive six-case diagnosis on 8 documents and 24 exposed DEV labels.
Gold is the independently saved audit label; no original-corpus inspection or annotation adjudication.
Missing-clause effects require a new authorized experiment and are not inferred here.

next_direction.boundary: Freeze one materially different hypothesis and independent data roles before measurement. No threshold, prompt, grouping or retrieval grid on these 24 exposed DEV questions. Preserve unused confirmation roles; all epoch22 slots remain closed.
next_direction.performed_now: Saved-trace diagnosis only; no source edit, fitting, calibration, model rerun, counterfactual feed or confirmation use.
next_direction.priority: Prioritize independent legal typed-reader and scope qualification on separate licensed development examples: copy versus retention, incoming versus outgoing disclosure, permission conditions, and exception-header dependencies. A source-scope dependency representation is a distinct candidate hypothesis; do not assume it repairs complete-document reader errors.

selection: Six purposive cases, not a representative sample; cases overlap contradiction errors and binary disagreements.
